subject: Annual OKR signal & budget orbit — planning kickoff
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual OKR signal & budget orbit — planning kickoff

Team —

Kicking off our annual planning orbit. This thread captures the initial ask and timeline so we can move from individual inputs -> consolidated deck -> exec QBR. High level asks:

- By Mon Aug 16 EOD: each leader to post a one‑page signal (explicit targets + 2 scenario bands: conservative / upside) using the attached planning_signal_v1.xlsx.
- By Fri Aug 20: synthesis from Marissa (owner) into consolidated target bands and a list of contingency levers.
- By Tue Aug 31: final slides and ask for exec QBR.

Please call out: absolute ARR targets, headcount asks by function, top 3 risks, and any infrastructure/capacity needs tied to latency or throughput. Finance will apply guardrails; Marcus, can you post a short note on constraints and any hard cutoffs? Stephanie, please include any capacity or region availability items that could change the ask.

Attachments: planning_playbook_v1.pdf (process), planning_signal_v1.xlsx (template)

Thanks — let’s keep the first round crisp. I’ll host a 30m alignment sync Mon Aug 16 11:00 PT if helpful. RSVP in the Drive calendar.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual OKR signal & budget orbit — planning kickoff

Folks —

Posting quick finance guardrails so teams can align asks to reality. See attached for details (finance_guardrails_27.pdf). Highlights:

- Operating budget growth constrained to +42% year over year baseline unless a clear >70% ARR growth case is made.
- Headcount: baseline +12 FTEs across the company; any ask above that requires a linked revenue trigger or reallocation.
- Contingency reserve: finance recommends an 8% opex buffer for macro uncertainty.
- Capital: major hardware orders (> $250k) need Procurement signoff 60 days out; longer lead times for specific GPU SKUs.

Also: request product leads to annotate any efficiency gains tied to Redwood Optimize (batching/quantization) as line items — we want to prioritize asks with clear unit-cost improvements.

— Marcus
VP, Finance
Attachment: finance_guardrails_27.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual OKR signal & budget orbit — planning kickoff

Team —

Strategic note from my side: priority is growth with sustainable unit economics. Proposed directional bands:

- Conservative: ARR growth 55–65% (focus on margin preservation)
- Base: ARR growth 66–75% (our planning target; aim for 70%)
- Upside: ARR growth 76–90% (requires accelerated sales motions and additional marketing investment)

Recommend we hold at least one contingency scenario that preserves a hiring freeze across non‑customer‑facing roles. Marcus' 8% reserve sounds reasonable; we should model the P&L impact of two staffing models side-by-side.

— Laura
Chief Operating Officer
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual OKR signal & budget orbit — planning kickoff

Quick ops constraints to flag:

- Dedicated capacity scaling: two specific GPU SKUs we rely on have 8‑12 week lead times; any ramp requiring additional Dedicated capacity needs procurement initiated by Sep 1.
- Private deployments: any new on‑prem/air‑gapped deals will add provisioning and compliance time (~6–10 weeks).
- Regional capacity: EU region has shorter available headroom in Q4 — we should annotate region-specific delivery risk on asks.

I'll add a short slide to the Drive that maps lead times to impact (latency SLOs, throughput).

— Steph
Head of Cloud Ops
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

I scheduled a 30m sync Tue Aug 17 1:00 PT to run through timelines and procurement windows; invite sent. For internal owners: please have the one‑page signal uploaded to the Drive by EOD Mon so I can fold external asks into the synthesis.

— Marissa

Hi Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for the invite. LumenHealth is approaching our contract renewal and we want to ensure any capacity or pricing changes that come from your planning cycle are surfaced early. Specific asks from our side:

- A clear procurement timeline for Dedicated capacity and expected pricing bands for Q1 (we need this to align budget approvals).
- Any SKUs or hardware lead times that could delay rollouts for our on‑prem pilots.
- Confirmation of SLA tiers you intend to offer for enterprise customers next year.

Happy to discuss on the Tue sync. Appreciate the transparency — it helps speed procurement approvals on our side.

Best,
Maya Thompson
